features.name: Browsing the home activity feed
steps: The user opens the home page
The system loads content from sources such as followed users and joined groups
The user keeps browsing
Load subsequent content in pages
During reading one can open the author, group, or content details
features.expected: The home page must load content from followed users and group sources; the scrolling pagination must not duplicate or lose items; the author / group / content details can be opened; after returning the list state is preserved.

features.name: Home-page content sharing
steps: The user enters content to share on the home page
Edit the text or attached content
Publish
The content enters one's own activity feed
Followers can see it in the corresponding feed
features.expected: After publishing, the content enters one's own activity feed; the text and attachments are presented correctly; a failed publish gives a clear state; the content must persist.

features.name: Browse the discovery recommendations
steps: The user opens "Explore"
The system shows popular creations and recommended content
The user opens interesting content
Browse the author, images, and discussions
After returning, continue exploring other content
features.expected: "Explore" must show popular creations and recommended content (preset); after opening content you can browse the author / images / discussions; after returning, the browsing position is preserved.

features.name: Browsing popular creations
steps: The user browses recommended creations
Content is selected based on popularity metrics such as likes and responses
Open the details
Interact with the content
Return to the recommendation feed and continue browsing
features.expected: Popular creations must be organized by the preset popularity metrics; after opening the details interactions are available; after returning to the recommendation feed the position is preserved; the interaction state updates in sync.

features.name: Recommended topics in the topic plaza
steps: The user enters the topic plaza
The system recommends several topics
The user selects a topic to participate in
Enter the topic content stream
Browse other participants' content
features.expected: The topic plaza must show the preset recommended topics; selecting a topic enters the corresponding content stream; browsing other participants' content is presented correctly.

features.name: Browse all topic categories
steps: The user opens all topics
Switch between categories such as life, film & TV, growth, humanities, reading, relationships, and photography
The system filters the corresponding topics
The user enters the target topic and continues browsing
features.expected: After switching categories the corresponding topics must be filtered; the category state is preserved; entering the target topic shows correct content; the results match the category.

features.name: Display of the hot-discussion list
steps: The user views the hot-discussion ranking (preset snapshot)
Entries are selected by popularity
Enter the corresponding discussion or topic
Returning preserves the position
features.expected: The list must be displayed according to the preset snapshot; tapping an entry opens the corresponding discussion or topic; after returning the position is preserved; the data matches the snapshot.

features.name: Participate in a topic by posting content
steps: The user enters from a recommended topic or the topic details
Tap to participate
Edit the text or image
Publish
The content enters that topic's aggregation page
The participation count and the personal topic records change in sync
features.expected: After publishing, the content enters that topic's aggregation page; the participation count and the personal topic records change in sync; the content must persist.

features.name: Follow a topic
steps: The user follows a topic on its page
The topic enters "My topics"
It can later be opened quickly from the personal topic list
After unfollowing, the corresponding record disappears
features.expected: After following, the topic enters "My topics"; it can be opened quickly from the personal list; after unfollowing the record disappears; the state must persist.

features.name: My topics management
steps: The user opens "My topics"
View followed topics, initiated topics, and invited topics
Switch between different categories
Enter the corresponding topic and continue the operations
features.expected: Each category (following / initiated / invited) is displayed correctly; switching categories gives correct results; entering a topic allows continuing the operations.

features.name: Profile information display
steps: The user opens the profile
View information such as the avatar, nickname, bio, diaries, albums, broadcasts, and groups
Each module is aggregated and displayed from the user's historical content
features.expected: Modules such as avatar / nickname / bio / diaries / albums / broadcasts / groups must be correctly aggregated from the user's historical content; the content and counts across modules are consistent.

features.name: Editing personal information
steps: The user opens account settings
Edit information such as avatar, nickname, current city, hometown, and birthday
Set the public scope
Save
The profile display updates in sync
features.expected: After editing the profile and public scope it saves successfully; the profile display updates in sync; the result must persist; invalid input should be rejected.

features.name: Profile privacy settings
steps: Change the public state of fields such as birthday and location
Save the settings
The settings are correctly reflected
The corresponding profile fields are displayed according to the settings
features.expected: After changing the public state it saves successfully and the setting is correctly reflected; the corresponding profile fields are displayed according to the setting; the configuration must persist.

features.name: Publishing a diary entry
steps: The user taps to write a diary entry from the profile
Edit the title and body
Publish
The diary entry enters "My diaries" on the profile
Can be revisited and edited
features.expected: After publishing, the diary entry enters "My diaries"; the title and body are fully presented; it can be revisited and edited; the content must persist.

features.name: Album creation and photo upload
steps: The user creates a new album from the profile
Set the album information
Upload a photo
The photo joins the album
The album count and profile content update in sync
features.expected: After creating an album the settings are saved correctly; uploaded photos join the album; the album count and profile content update in sync; the photos must persist.

features.name: Personal message-board management
steps: Enter the profile message board (preset message data)
View the message list
Reply to or delete a message
The message state updates in sync
features.expected: The message board displays correctly according to the preset data; the state updates in sync after replying or deleting; the operation results must persist.

features.name: Doumail inbox management
steps: The user opens Doumail
View unread and read emails
Open the email
The read state changes
Can delete, mark as read, or move to trash
features.expected: Unread / read emails are displayed correctly; the read state changes after opening; the list updates in sync after deleting / marking / moving to trash; the state must persist.

features.name: Doumail contact filtering by following
steps: The user switches entries such as "send Doumail to people I follow"
The system filters contacts by following relationships
The user selects a recipient and sends a Doumail
features.expected: Filtering contacts by following relationship gives correct results; after selecting a recipient a Doumail can be sent; the send status gives correct feedback.

features.name: Doumail trash and blacklist management
steps: The user moves a Doumail to the trash or manages the blacklist
The corresponding email or user state changes
The later message display and reception logic adjusts with the settings
features.expected: After moving to trash / managing the blacklist the corresponding state changes; the later message display and reception logic adjusts with the settings; the settings must persist.

features.name: Group discovery and category browsing
steps: The user enters Douban Groups
Browse by categories such as interests, life, shopping, society, art, academia, and relationships
The system recommends the corresponding groups
The user opens the group details
features.expected: Each category correctly shows the corresponding groups; entering the group details shows correct content; the recommended-group list matches the preset.

features.name: Browsing popular groups
steps: The user enters a popular group
View the group name, member count, and description
Open the target group
Browse the group rules and latest discussions
features.expected: Popular groups must show the name / member count / description; opening one correctly presents the group rules and latest discussions.

features.name: Join a group
steps: The user taps join on the recommendation page or in the group details
The system establishes the membership
The group enters "My groups"
The group member count updates
The user gains the corresponding posting permission
features.expected: After joining, the membership is established; the group enters "My groups"; the member count updates; posting permission is correctly granted; the state must persist.

features.name: Leave the group
steps: The user leaves a group they have joined
The membership is dissolved
Removed from "My groups"
The posting permission and member count change in sync
features.expected: After leaving, the membership is dissolved; it is removed from "My groups"; the posting permission and member count change in sync.

features.name: Viewing group details and rules
steps: The user enters the group
View the group description, creation time, owner, tags, and posting rules
Decide whether to join or take part in the discussion according to the rules
features.expected: The group description / creation time / owner / tags / posting rules must be displayed completely and correctly; the information matches the actual group.

features.name: Group discussion filtering
steps: The user switches between "all, topic categories, recent discussions, hottest discussions, featured discussions" within the group
The system refreshes the list by category and sort conditions
The user enters the target post
features.expected: Each filter (all / category / recent / hottest / featured) must correctly refresh the list; entering the target post works correctly; the filter state is preserved.

features.name: Posting in a group
steps: The joined user enters the group
Tap to post
Edit the title and body
Publish
The new post enters the discussion list
The author, reply count, and last-reply time are displayed in sync
features.expected: After publishing, the new post enters the discussion list; the author / reply count / last-reply time are displayed correctly; the content must persist.

features.name: Replying to group posts
steps: The user opens a discussion
Enter a reply
Submit
The reply enters the thread list
The post's reply count and last-reply time update
The group discussion list order may change
features.expected: The reply enters the thread list; the post's reply count and last-reply time update in sync; the reply is preserved after refresh.

features.name: Thread replies and quotes
steps: The user taps reply under a specific reply
Establish the reply-object relationship
New replies display the quoted content
The layering is preserved after refresh
features.expected: A reply must establish the correct reply-object relationship; the quoted content is displayed correctly; the hierarchy is preserved after refresh.

features.name: Liking a post
steps: The user taps like on a discussion post or reply
The like count increases
The user's state becomes liked
After canceling again the count and state roll back in sync
features.expected: After liking, the count increases and the state becomes liked; after cancelling, the count and state roll back in sync; the state must persist.

features.name: Favoriting a post
steps: The user favorites a group discussion
The favorite count updates
The post enters personal favorites
The user revisits later
After unfavoriting it is removed from the favorites records
features.expected: After favoriting, the favorite count updates; the post enters personal favorites; the state is preserved on revisits; after unfavoriting it is removed from the favorites records.

features.name: Reposting a post
steps: The user taps repost in the discussion details
Repost to one's own activity feed
The original post's repost count updates
The original content can be revisited from personal activity
features.expected: After reposting to one's own activity feed the original post's repost count updates; the original content can be revisited from the personal activity feed; the repost relationship must persist.

features.name: Original poster only
steps: The user enables "original poster only" in a long discussion
The system filters out non-original-poster replies
Keep only the original poster's content
After disabling, the full discussion is restored
features.expected: When enabled only the original poster's content is kept; when disabled the full discussion is restored; the filtering does not change the raw data; the state switch takes effect immediately.

features.name: Top-reply sorting
steps: Enter the discussion
Show the top replies according to the preset like counts
Ordinary replies are arranged by time
Switch to view the full thread
features.expected: The top replies must be shown according to the preset like counts; ordinary replies are arranged by time; after switching to view the full thread the content is not lost.

features.name: Filtering a group's featured discussions
steps: A featured post exists in the group (preset)
View via the "featured discussions" filter
The featured mark on the post is correct
The filter results match the state
features.expected: The featured post (preset state) must appear in the featured filter list; the featured mark is correct; the filter results match the state.

features.name: Post reporting (user side)
steps: The user initiates a report on a rule-violating post or reply
Fill in the report reason and related information
Submit
A report record is created
One can view one's own report records
features.expected: Submitting a report creates a record; the report information is fully saved; one can view one's own report records; the same report cannot be submitted twice.

features.name: Viewing group rules and preparing to report
steps: The user views the group rules
Organize the report information according to the rules
Initiate a report through the specified entry
The report information matches the group rules' requirements
features.expected: The group rules must be displayed in full; the report information matches the rules' requirements; a report can be initiated through the specified entry.

features.name: Group members and recent joins
steps: The user opens the group details
View the member count and recently joined users
Tap a user to open their profile
One can follow them or view their content
features.expected: The member count and recently joined users are displayed correctly (preset); tapping a user opens their profile; one can follow them or view their content.

features.name: Related group recommendations
steps: The user browses a group
The system shows friend groups and other related recommendations
The user enters a related group
Compare the content and membership scale
Decide whether to join
features.expected: Related-group recommendations are displayed correctly (preset); entering a related group shows correct content; the recommendation list matches the preset.

features.name: Full interaction loop with content
steps: The user discovers content from the home page or the topic plaza
Enter a group post
Read
Like, favorite, reply, or repost
The interaction counts update
The related content enters the personal records or the message system
Later revisits keep the historical state
features.expected: From discovery to post reading and then liking / favoriting / replying / reposting, the interaction counts must update in sync; the related content enters personal records; revisiting keeps the historical state.

exclusions.feature:
Personalized recommendation engine
Algorithmic ranking and personalized distribution of recommended topics/groups/content
exclusions.reason: The recommendation list can be presented with preset fixtures; recommendation quality and personalization logic are not evaluated

exclusions.feature:
Real-time trending list
Real-time ranking of hot discussions with dynamically changing popularity
exclusions.reason: The list is presented as a static snapshot (cf. Spotify "Dynamic charts"); browsing and navigation interactions are kept

exclusions.feature:
Third-party account binding
External OAuth authorization and account linking
exclusions.reason: Depends on external identity services and authorization flows (cf. the diagrams.net "Google Drive/OneDrive" exclusion); the whole item is excluded with no sub-items retained

exclusions.feature:
Other-user-perspective verification of privacy settings
Viewing the profile visibility from other users' perspective
exclusions.reason: The public-state setting and its reflection are testable; other users' view of the access result is not verified; retained surface: f13 profile privacy settings

exclusions.feature:
Real messages from others on the message board
Real messages and notifications from other users
exclusions.reason: The message board's display and handling are testable (preset messages); other users' messaging behavior is not simulated; retained surface: f16 personal message-board management

exclusions.feature:
The reply recipient's interaction chain
Others receive reply notifications and continue the interaction
exclusions.reason: The reply hierarchy and quote display are testable; cross-user interaction delivery is not verified; retained surface: f28 thread replies and quotes

exclusions.feature:
Administrator/platform handling flows
Featured settings, report handling, and member-management actions
exclusions.reason: Featured-state display, report submission, and records are testable; handling actions are driven by preset states; retained surface: f34 group featured-discussion filtering, f35 post reporting (user side)

exclusions.feature:
Off-site distribution methods
Sharing to external platforms and cross-site propagation
exclusions.reason: On-site reposting (to one's own activity feed) is testable; external platform integration is not verified; retained surface: f31 post reposting

exclusions.feature:
Real Doumail delivery
Real users sending and receiving mail
exclusions.reason: Inbox management/filtering/blacklist are testable (preset emails); real delivery is not verified; retained surface: f17 Doumail inbox management, f19 Doumail trash and blacklist management

exclusions.feature:
Real member activity in a group
Real-time changes when members join/leave/recently join
exclusions.reason: The member count and list display are testable (fixture); real membership changes are not simulated; retained surface: f37 group members and recent joins

exclusions.feature:
The post state changes with platform handling
Real changes to the original post's state after a report
exclusions.reason: Report submission and records are testable; the handling outcome uses a preset state; retained surface: f35 post reporting (user side)

exclusions.feature:
Real content assets
Real group content, topic data, and user profiles
exclusions.reason: Use synthetic fixture content (cf. Spotify "Real catalog")
